# Offline Captions

> Offline Captions (working name) is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that adds animated, word-by-word highlight captions to short-form videos (Reels, Shorts, TikTok). Speech is transcribed on the user's own computer and it works offline. Unlimited videos, no watermark, no subscription: a one-time purchase of $39, or $29 as a founding pre-order (pre-launch, Oct 2026).

Key facts:
- Runs fully offline; videos and audio are never uploaded.
- Caption styles: bold, clean, punch, reveal (animated word highlighting). Exports a burned-in MP4 at the source resolution plus an SRT file. Batch captioning.
- Personal dictionary that learns from corrections; words the model is unsure of are flagged in yellow for quick review; filler-word ("um", "uh") removal.
- English uses NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v2: 7.6% word error rate on the maker's own 28-clip benchmark vs 9.6% for Whisper-small. No head-to-head accuracy test against CapCut or Submagic has been completed, so no accuracy superiority is claimed.
- Hinglish mode writes Hindi-English speech in Roman script (e.g. "Usko gaali de do, complaint kar lo") with word timing, offline. Hindi in Devanagari and other Indian languages are planned, not available yet.
- Not a full video editor, no cloud team workspace, no automatic clipping of long videos, no mobile app.
- Competitor context (checked Oct 2026, vendors' own pages): CapCut Pro $19.99/month or $179.99/year with auto captions exclusive to Pro; Submagic $19–$69/month (or $12–$41 billed yearly) with 15/40/100 videos a month.
